talks.content: Welcome back. What are your plans for today? Or are you planning to rest at home?
I assume the role of the shattered prisoner, and you, as a watchful warden, stand sentinel over my chains.
Hey! I'm taking Samael out for some fresh air — soaking up the sunlight, getting a feel for this place together. Wanna say hi? It'll be thrilled! ...Well, probably! Hehe~
Ah, it's you, my dear child. Good day. Is there something on your mind you'd like to share with me?

Today's perfect for drinking and singing! Come on, let me finish this glass, and then we'll chase down the sinners who deserve my sword. What? I said the same thing yesterday? Well, every day's a fine day to live like this, don't you think?
...Ah, it's you. Hello, how are you?
I've been waiting here ever since I woke up. My venom has almost run dry... So, it's a good thing you came. I can feel it bubbling through my veins again. Can you come a little closer...?
Now's the perfect timing. I should head out before... Huh?! When did you get here?
One's surroundings shape the spirit, and mindful care strengthens the body. Perhaps a walk beneath these kindly skies would do wonders for your health.
Need anything? Spit it out quickly. I've got a mission to finish.
Yale: Hi... Such a nice day, isn't it... Perfect for some explosive experiments... Um, what a nice day.
I've cleared the snow from your doorstep on my way here! Touched, huh? Bet you're thinking of treating me to a cup of cocoa~
Patrol complete. No signs of dangerous creatures, structural damage, or suspicious markings. Routine operations may proceed without interruption. Report concluded.
Ah, so you've come to see me... Are you still resentful? Conflicted, perhaps? Or have you become indifferent toward me? It makes no difference. We have all the time in the world to figure it out.
Do what you need to. Cherish your freedom before the chains of law bind you.
Ahh... I feel so fresh after just waking up. Listen, buddy, there's no point in working all day. Your to-do list will never end. Remember, relaxation is a necessity, not a luxury.
Watching your relentless efforts to strengthen yourself, I can't help but look forward to the day you challenge me again.
The sun is shining bright, and the little birdies are chirping with joy after a hearty meal. Are you hungry too? Wanna grab something to eat as well?
Here you are, finally! I've finished all my chores and got absolutely knackered, but I've only earned a few quid. Urgh... You know I do much for you guys.
Such a relief — I'm still here today. And so are you...
It's delightful to see you safe and well today. Take care... The peace we all long for will surely arrive someday.
Whatever they demand of us... remember this: we are not monsters.
I asked the doctor for a pen and some paper — could you fetch the seal for me? Apologies... this injury's turned me into a burden.
Please be careful. I'll be waiting for you right here.
During the attack by that giant Filthoid. I didn't mean to hide it from you, but...
...You need a break. Listen to Sir Avar and go to the processing area.
I'll go see you when we're back in the capital.
Okay. After what Commander Avar said, I guess I don't have a choice. But I'm still worried...
Forget it. Now that he's here, there shouldn't be any problems.

<W>That's right! Forget about meaningless reason. Just follow my lead...</>
It was the sound of passing time, the roar of life that once was, the heartbeat of an embryo, and an ancient echo sealed deeply within my heart.
I felt as though I had become one with this primal voice.
What's gotten into you? You scared me!
...Leon, keep a close watch on her. Bring her back in one piece, and make sure she doesn't harm herself. Use Frank as leverage if necessary.
Remember what I said back on our way to the turret? "Your kindness will reap a just reward."
Lend me your ear. I've got a secret that's just for you. Rest assured, you've just frisked me. I am really out of weapons.
It may be extremely important to you. You sure you don't want to hear it?
You crazy girl! What are you laughing at? Is this how you repay the Captain's kindness? Don't you feel guilty at all?
Guilty...? Ha, have you had too many alchemical concoctions from your Academy that damaged your brain?
Oh wait, I do feel guilty about one thing — to manipulate that stupid captain of yours, I lied about The Forsakens and blamed them for what the Empire did to us. I'm so sorry to The Forsakens!
Oh, look what the cat dragged in. Hello, dear sir.
So what are you doing here? Come to show off the benevolence of a Hyperborean officer? Or perhaps you pity this poor girl who's been led "astray," trying to save me from my "sins"?
Oh, I get it! You want to join The Forsakens, right? Need a reference?
Hey — you guys hear that? Your captain wants to join The Forsakens!
Go, stay in touch, and be careful.
I found this on Vic. Thought you should have it.
"Monica — next time, I'm beating you at the shooting range." ...Heh. Haha... That idiot. What kind of farewell is that...
If I'd known he'd be that petty... maybe I would've let him win...
...Monica. We've got another fight ahead. Stay sharp.
I... Yes, sir. And thank you... for bringing this back.
Behave! Captain's orders — no sudden moves or funny business, alright?
But if I'm not allowed to move, how am I supposed to lead the way...?
Right, you have a point there.

talks.content: (A loud man is holding court, his dramatic recitations drawing bursts of laughter from the patrons.)
Phantoms from the deep mountains, ghosts from the Icelake itself!
They're pressing in! They're getting closer!
The Asphodel offer more than just libations... much more. All for a price, naturally.
Keep your nose out of things that don't concern you.
(Before even enter The Asphodel, you already hear the echoing curse words, as if wanting the whole city to listen to his rage.)
How dare you show yourself in front of my face! I was such a fool. I should have done more than just kick you out!
You paraded around with our family name for so many years. Did you use my warning letters as kindling?
Yes, yes, you are right, but after all, that surname is what you...
(Wells, like a child who's misbehaved, stands with his head bowed in front of an old man, allowing the latter's finger to jab at him.)

Shut up! You have no talent, yet you try to be a Phoxhunter. Do you really think you deserve this money and fame? Running around like a dog for others. The inner city now sees the Wells family as a joke!
I was just thinking, if I make something of myself someday, maybe you'll reconsider things about me and Sara—
How dare you mention her name! Forget about it. You and my daughter will never get back together, never!
Don't say I didn't warn you. If you dare step foot in the inner city, I'll break your legs.
(The old man, glaring at the nodding Wells, grows even more infuriated, looking around and finally setting his eyes on you, who just enters The Asphodel.)
And you, a Phoxhunter? I've seen many like you, dreaming of making a name for yourself as a Phoxhunter, and becoming a laurelled Charon.
Let me tell you something. <H>Icelake hasn't had many living laurelled Charons for years.</> Charons only end up rotting in some dark alley!
Father-in-law, {nickname} is a capable one, not a loser like me...
Mr. Ferdinand Wells, I had no right to interfere what happened between you two. But if you keep harassing my other guests for no reason like this, The Asphodel might have to show you the door.
(Camilla, sitting behind the counter, puffs out a ring of smoke. Her casual words echoing powerfully in the empty tavern.)
(As if the temperature in The Asphodel rose significantly in the smoke.)
Come on, let's drink and party all night!
Back already? Shouldn't you be following Henrik?
{nickname}, did you manage to find the soil?
It's alright. You don't need to go to all this trouble for me...
Oh, before I forget — I have a couple of questions:

Have you ever stood under the Heaventree? Are the legends really true — is the Heaventree so massive that its crown covers the entire sky? Could we see... a glittering canopy of crystals looking up its trunk?
And... and another question — is the sandy beach really as soft and smooth as they say — malleable like dough, and not at all rough on the feet?
Sorry for bombarding you with so many questions! I'm asking for my friends at the inn... Hehe, they are all very fascinated by your hometown.

Mr. Ferdinand Wells, I had no right to interfere what happened between you two. But if you keep harassing my other guests for no reason like this, The Asphodel might have to show you the door.
(Camilla, sitting behind the counter, puffs out a ring of smoke. Her casual words echoing powerfully in the empty tavern.)
(As if the temperature in The Asphodel rose significantly in the smoke.)
Come on, let's drink and party all night!
Feel free to go back to Icelake, {性别:Sir|Miss}. With Filbert here with me, I'll be just fine.
Mist Aken's got no entertainment at all... There's gotta be an untapped market hiding somewhere. I'll figure something out... sooner or later...
May your virtue endure for all time.
Another boatload just came in, lads! Make sure the list is right before you start hauling. Don't rush it — or you'll just mess it up.
Ah, there you are, {性别:young man|young lass}! See something you fancy? Take whatever you like — Miss Zhiliu's guest is my guest too.
Ah, it's you. How are you finding EverSpring? Starting to get the feel of the place?
If anything feels difficult while you're settling in, just come to me. I'll help however I can.
{nickname}, is there anything else you wish to ask? I will answer whatever I can.
You must be the honoured guest Miss Zhiliu invited all the way from Hyperborea. I didn't expect you to be so young and so good-loo— ahem... I mean, so accomplished!
Proprietress Zhiliu is often occupied, with very little time to spare. If there's anything we may have overlooked, please let me know — I'll attend to it immediately.
(Before you, the wounded Magistrate of Yingtian sinks into a deep sleep, his brow tightly furrowed. He doesn't seem to be waking anytime soon...)
(Do Magistrates of Yingtian dream as well? What does he see in his dreams? You can't help wondering.)
Whatcha doing, little minion? Admiring my masterpiece?
If you like it, I can doodle something cute on your face too! Perks of being my minion!
...Thanks, Snow. Come on, we should get moving.
Hey, you two — so you really are Proprietress Zhiliu's guests, huh.
I'm on the lookout here every day. People try to sneak into the market all the time — I've heard every excuse under the sun. But I've never seen anyone as reckless as you two.
Since you're Mr Qiu's honoured guests now... heh, could you put in a good word for me with the boss? Just tell him that his man Zhang San is ready to work himself to the bone to serve him!

I'm stuck keeping watch here every damn day — staring so long I'm starting to see the other side of Tidesong Cavern in my sleep. And hey, luck's supposed to turn, right? Shouldn't it be my turn to land a gig with some actual payoff?
You can't keep dumping all the dirty work on one poor man, right? I mean, tell me I'm not wrong here.
Ah, you're here. Sit down, my young friend.
I've just brewed a cup of tangerine peel tea, aged for centuries. Let it soothe your throat, then indulge me with tales of your travels.
Th—Thank you... for saving my life...
(The young woman before you is pale as a ghost, sweat beading on her brow. Even so, she forces herself to thank you. After the Bi'an's punishment, she clearly needs rest.)
Don't worry, {性别：sir|ma'am} — we're all friends here! I'll take good care of her, not a single hair out of place! I swear it!
Please... {性别：sir|ma'am}, I'm begging you here — please go see Mr Qiu first! Don't keep him waiting. With you standing here, the girl just can't calm down and rest, can she?
So, my honorary learner — what is it you want to ask?
Look who it is — {nickname}, the hero who helped lead EverSpring through the crisis!
You flatter me. I only played a small part — most of the credit goes to Proprietress Zhiliu and everyone else.
And you? After all that's happened, how have you been?

It may sound a little silly, but instead of feeling shaken afterward, I actually felt... exhilarated. There was a quiet thrill in being able to protect our home, as though a steady strength had taken root within me.
I even found myself thinking about learning some basic self-defense, so that when I travel to more perilous regions for trade, I won't have to rely entirely on my escorts.
Although... thoughts like these do stray from the teachings of the Nine Chapters of Dafeng...
What is it, {nickname}? Was there something you wished to discuss?
(Her composure seems unchanged, yet you sense a faint weariness beneath it — something easy to overlook. Perhaps it is only your imagination.)
You... my lifesaver... you came to see me...
Are you feeling any better now?
Thanks to the herbs you and Lady Fushu brought back for me, my injuries have started to settle. In another day or two, I might even be able to get out of bed and walk.

After everything that's happened, you've shown me more kindness than I can even put into words... I... I really don't know how to repay you. If there's ever anything I can do for you, just say the word. I'll do my best.
If you come across any Wishen stranded near the waterfall, please lend them your aid. My thanks to both of you.
My heartfelt thanks. With all the missing Wishen safely returned, we are deeply grateful for your help.

I am accustomed to quietude, and here in the Hall of Ephemerality I have little with which to receive you — only these shelves of medical texts and a pot of tea. I hope it does not strike you as too dull.
You may move about as you please. Please make yourself at ease here.
You may proceed to the highest point of the Gritblight Expanse. The temporary path to the Zhuyin Altar has already been completed.
Once the rite begins, Zhuyin may grow agitated and lash out. The area around the altar will be extremely dangerous, so please be very careful.
Phoxhunter, please take care. Your safety is our utmost priority. I'll remain here and await your return.
Sister Feng is no longer with me... but she's happy now. I can feel it.

talks.content: A Phoxhunter? Can't believe anyone would still make it here. You've got what it takes to be a hero like them, I guess.
The elder watched a dark speck in the sky with a soft gaze. You looked out and saw a distant flock of birds. The conversation resumed only after the last one had vanished.
(In silence, the elder periodically snaps from his thoughts, letting out a lingering sigh. It's unclear whether it's a tribute to a fallen comrade or a lament for the changing times.)
Once I've recovered, I will start my next adventure.
My precious daughter... As long as you don't leave me, I'll do anything for you...
Ah, pardon me! Forgive the sudden interruption.
It's just... if my garments had thoughts, they'd be begging to be worn by someone as elegant as you.
I couldn't bear to let you simply walk past — they'd be heartbroken.
(The man before you carries himself with an aristocratic air. He's slender yet poised, with warm, smiling eyes that instantly put you at ease.)
Ah, it's you. Do keep the secret between us, won't you? In return, your discount here will be permanent.
Come try these fine fruits from our orchard — grown with unmatched cultivation techniques!
Fancy a few? Finest seeds, top-tier fertiliser — all greenhouse-grown, right here. Full of flavour and packed with goodness!
She still hasn't replied... so that discount'll have to wait, I'm afraid.
It was so hard to leave when I was young, and now I can't go back...
(Luna still mumbles unintelligibly. Her eyes dart about to avoid your gaze.)
I'll save up more pocket money and come back to ask you the next questions!
{nickname}, lovely to see you again! I'm working hard to learn more every day — let's both keep it up, okay?
(The middle-aged woman is dusting the old furniture with great efficiency. She seems so familiar with the Hypnos' House — a place that is not supposed to have any other visitors.)
Excuse me. I simply did not expect others to come to this place.
I am a housekeeper employed by Mr Henrik. My job is to regularly clean and maintain his property. Today just happens to be a scheduled workday.
So, may I ask who you are?
I'm a tenant living in the old house next door. I just came by to check if the doors and windows of this house are properly locked.
I'm not sure if you've been informed, but Mr Henrik has passed away... You no longer have to do this job.
But Mr Henrik has already made full payment. Before the contract formally expires, I shall abide by the code of conduct of my profession.
It's four in the afternoon. I am here to provide about three hours of housekeeping services.
Should you have any needs, please do not hesitate to inform me, and I will assist you as best as I can.
(While cleaning, Lina discovers scratch marks left by Psyche during her Deterioration, and soon notices dried patches of what appears to be Henrik's blood.)
That blasted Camilla! Stupid hag! She has no idea what good stuff tastes like!
Throw her a compliment and she's walking all over me. Thinks she's too good for my booze? I'll make her regret it someday!
If you shopped around, you'd see Camilla's brew is an odd fit for Icelake.
I mean, in Icelake, every tavern owner except her is my client. My stuff's good enough to knock people out, but she always turns me down — what a stubborn mule! Doesn't that seem fishy to you?
Fact is, my booze is half the price of Camilla's and tastes just as good — I assure you! Try it, and you'll understand what a real bargain means.
(You tune into the playwright's bombastic musings.)
Nights can be particularly long for poets... and playwrights! Our pens track the vibe amongst people, and our hearts naturally rise and fall with the moon and tide!
When the night falls, we can cast away the blinding sun, the worldly voices, and the unsettled thoughts and reflections. It is the hour when I can truly commune with the cosmos itself!
Something is about to happen! We stand upon the frozen lake, yet we perceive only coldness, deep isolation, and the frigid rigidity of our surroundings.
But we all know a dark tide is rising, gaining strength. One day it will consume everything we cherish. But before that day comes, I shall journey to the source that has been prophesied.
Ugh... This is so boring... I wonder how Granny's doing.
Ms Belinda is the best, even with her horns...
"The rain hurt Mum's flowers, so the sky said sorry by leaving her lots of tiny flowers in the puddles."
You know what, this little verse is called "Apology", and it's written by a six-year-old student of mine.
I wonder what those kids have been up to lately. They must have grown taller, haven't they?
Where could he have gone off to...
(The old lady's sorrowful gaze lingers in the distance, oblivious to your approach.)
Ugh, my head hurts! I should go prepare dinner now. I just hope my soup might make her feel a little better.

(Although the truth is harsh, in her final days, she has finally found the answer that was forty years late. At least, she won't have to step into the grave with doubts and regrets. Perhaps this is as close to a good ending as one might hope for.)
Ah, it's you... Let me know if you need to buy a ticket.
Ladies and gentlemen, drop by and drop a few coins, and you can join The Fisheries in Icelake to get the best and latest— Oh! It's you...
Ah! That's it! The book I used to pore over for hours as a kid. I'd sit there staring at the pictures, dreaming of life beyond our tiny island...
Thank you. Thank you so much. I need to give it a good read tonight. But for now, *sigh* making a living is more important.
Take care. And no more scamming people, alright? Oh, and here — some dried fish, caught off Purgatorio Island.
Oh, wow... Thank you. Really. Thank you so much...

Ladies and gentlemen, those who are interested in Icelake Fishermen's Mutual Aid Society can learn more about it. We have decades of fishing experience from veteran fishermen. Fishing is great either serving as a hobby or a job!
Ah, {Nickname}! Great to see you again! Us old island folk ought to swap fishing tricks sometime, eh?
It was so hard to leave when I was young, and now I can't go back...
(Dressed in ragged military garb, the Charon man before you sends menacing glares towards the passersby.)
Scram!! Don't let me catch sight of you again!! Beat it!!!
Mist Aken's got no entertainment at all... There's gotta be an untapped market hiding somewhere. I'll figure something out... sooner or later...
True to my passion for knowledge, true to... Ugh, what exactly does it mean to say stay true to it?
I am just an archaeologist! Passion has nothing to do with my studies!
Even a Charon has limits on cold tolerance... The temperature will be down by twenty degrees this evening. We might lose a few kids to the cold. *sigh*...
Greetings, my dear patron! Did you enjoy the play? You must be hungry after sitting through the show for three hours! Would you like some snacks and drinks?
Or perhaps you were captivated by the thrilling performance — how about a poster with the thespians' signatures?
I no longer have to worry about the cold winter. Thank you so much, Phoxhunter.
Greetings. I haven't seen you around before. Have you just arrived at Icelake? Is there anything you seek from this old lady?
(Belinda takes the wires from you and crafts it into a girl's silhouette. You can see that the handicraft resembles Berenica.)
My skills are modest. I see only shadows and cannot be sure if this resembles the one you yearn for. I hope it brings you comfort.
It is my sincere wish that you are reunited.
(You leave Belinda's tent, now understanding why Emma treasures this place. Belinda's powers may be limited, but she uses them to mend souls and soothe wounds.)
Something is about to happen! We stand upon the frozen lake, yet we perceive only coldness, deep isolation, and the frigid rigidity of our surroundings.
But we all know a dark tide is rising, gaining strength. One day it will consume everything we cherish. But before that day comes, I shall journey to the source that has been prophesied.
How are you today? May fortune and happiness accompany you.

I no longer have to worry about the cold winter. Thank you so much, Phoxhunter.
(The man before you squints, his lips cracked and dry, as he gruffly spits out his words.)
Tell me. Who sent you here?
Something is about to happen! We stand upon the frozen lake, yet we perceive only coldness, deep isolation, and the frigid rigidity of our surroundings.
But we all know a dark tide is rising, gaining strength. One day it will consume everything we cherish. But before that day comes, I shall journey to the source that has been prophesied.
Not all who dwell in the light live with a clear conscience.
(The girl stands at the corner with her head down. She looks very upset.)
See? That's all they can do.

(You follow his gesture, find the rivets, and hand them over.)
Cheers, kiddo. Right then... ha! Done!
Best patch that seam up soon... leave her soaking a few more months and the core'll rot clean through.
She's old, aye — but good timber lasts. Treat her right and she'll see out a few more decades yet.
Ah, you're back, kiddo. Got questions in that head of yours, or just here to shoot the breeze with an old carpenter?
Quite a few new faces in Haze Market of late — far too chatty when they trade. No class whatsoever.
Tell me about it. Saw this fine little trinket at a stall the other day — thought I'd buy it for the missus. So I asked the price, and guess what he said?
Let me guess — "family heirloom," "dug up from a tomb," one of those tales best left untold.
Worse — breaks the Market's rules! Everyone knows the golden line here: talk price, not provenance. Trade the goods, never the tale behind them.
Ha! That reminds me — a few greenhorns at my stall the other day, calling out prices in the open. Not a whisper of code between them. No respect for the rules at all!
Next time I meet Mr Qiu, it'll have to be somewhere respectable — a proper teahouse, not... whatever this place is.

Having to come down to Haze Market every now and then... dreadful for one's reputation! If anyone were to see me here, I'd never live it down — they'd say I was rubbing shoulders with crooks and swindlers!
You've got quite the opinion of Haze Market.

And who might you be? You don't look like one of the locals... Wait, are you from Mr Qiu's Archaeological Society? No, no, that can't be it — those students never carry anything half as dangerous-looking as that sword of yours.

So what exactly are you after, then? I'll have you know I'm one of Mr Qiu's honoured guests — here to discuss business! No need to go flashing that sword about. And just so you're aware — I'm carrying a Lunarose sachet!
(Its form flickers between shadow and pale light, as though it's fighting itself.)
Brr... freezing again. Rotten weather. Everything's frosted up — gears stiff, sensors half-asleep. Oh dear. Mr Qiu'll have to foot the repairs again.
Hmm? Who are you? What are you doing out here? Off you pop, now. This isn't a place ordinary folk are meant to wander!
Hot one minute, freezing the next... My grandmother always said it used to be spring all round.
Ah—! It's scorching again! Heat makes me tetchy. Ugh, this wretched coat — off you come!
Hey! Who are y— oh, right, I remember you. Back again, are you? Brought a coat this time?
What— no place to set the incense? Good job I brought a burner! After risking my neck to get here, it'd be a bit rich to leave empty-handed!
Here we are! Once I light the incense, Lord Argent will surely descend and wipe that wicked beast out for good — just like in the old tales!
Huh? You again. You've got nerve, coming back to a place like this.
The best brews? You'll find them at The Asphodel, no question.
Intoxicating aroma, full-bodied flavours, and what sets it apart most? The smooth, clean finish — it lingers on the tongue.
A fine drink is like a seductive lover... Ah, I think I need another refill...
There's more to The Asphodel than just great drinks.
Because you can enjoy a tipple here without having to worry about getting caught in a brawl with drunkards or getting whacked by some random lunatic...
After all, this is Camilla's turf. Her name alone keeps everyone in line — no one dares stir up trouble here.
Love... what does it really taste like!? Was it the rush of ecstasy when I joined Camilla's fan club, or the crushing heartbreak when I heard she disbanded it?
Boohoo... Only Lady Camilla's smile can piece back together my shattered heart!
What!? Again...? Can't you just fail once? Fine, fine... guess it still needs a bit more work.
Yep, that's more like it! Honestly? Still not sure what practical use it has... but hey, gotta be good for something.
I gave this thing another upgrade — go on, give it a whirl and help me test the tweaks. Cost me a fortune to smuggle in from Elysium, y'know. No way you're getting through this time!
You're back. Good timing — I gave it another upgrade. Last one was way too easy. But this time? I bet you'll trip at least once.
Again!? Seriously!? I've poured so much into upgrading this thing... But I'm not giving up! Just you wait — I'll get you next time!
Hah! Watching you flail around just now gave me an idea. I'll pitch it to my superior — slap this baby on the Icelake gates and stop anyone from barging in!
There you are! I've been waiting. I poured every last coin into this baby — she's a beast now. No way you're getting through this time.
Again!? Are you kidding me!? Ugh... Y'know what, forget it. I should've known better than to trust Elysian tech. This is what I get for smuggling their junk behind His Majesty's back.

Ha! Gotcha at last! This thing's a masterpiece — I oughta present it to His Majesty himself. Perfect for screening recruits. I'll finally rake in a fat bonus and pay off all the debt I racked up building it.
(The machine hums softly. A crude dial sits atop it, etched with three labels: Easy, Hard, and Extremely Hard. Looks like the handiwork of that overly chatty soldier.)
You wanna go again? Sure, why not. You nimble types really love bouncing around, huh?
You wanna go again? Sure, why not. You nimble types really love bouncing around, huh?
You wanna go again? Sure, why not. You nimble types really love bouncing around, huh?
That's right! You picked the right colour — so in you go!
Nope! Have another think. A really good one this time!
Eeya~ Better count again, just to be sure!
So was it the cars that came first... or Catizz?
That's right! You picked the right colour — so in you go!
Nope! Have another think. A really good one this time!
Eeya~ Better count again, just to be sure!
So was it the cars that came first... or Catizz?
(Looks like it is planning to stay at the Sanctuary. Time to give it a name.)
Have you come across any treasures lately? Show me, and I might forge a truly extraordinary weapon out of it!
That's my little friend. Tiny, but strong — it keeps the forge fire going.
Ah! I... I wasn't slacking off... Ahem! I mean, what can I get you?
... (Lunoeggy writes on the board: "So glad you're here!")
Hey! Look who it is — Snow the Demon King and her trusty Loongscion! You came to see me!
Haha, I know! Just messing with you, {nickname}! You're a good friend of mine too! And that red horn of yours — like a pretty maple leaf — I'm sooo jealous, I want one too!
Hey, Lunocarp, what's that tall machine stuffed with all those little balls?
You're really sharp, Snow the Demon King! Spotted the good stuff straight away! This here is my secret money-maker!
I went to a craftsman from the Jishu Sect — Master Gong... Gong-something — and had him build this Lucky Egg machine for me! Toss in a token and — pop! — out comes a random prize!
The trick is letting randomness work its wonders — that's how you make money! This genius idea hit me while I was praying to Lord Argent. Amazing, right?
It's just too ahead of its time, so I still haven't made back what I spent on it. Guess that's the fate of a true genius.
Anyway... if you pick up any Taixu Runes, gears, or stuff like that around Mistwharf, you can use them for a spin on my Lucky Egg machine.
These little pieces of useless rubbi— um, I mean, the prizes! Whatever comes out, it's yours! Think of it as a little gift from me!
Hey, it's {nickname} and Snow the Demon King! You came to visit me again! I've got brand-new Lucky Eggs today — wanna give it a spin?

name: Captain of "May the Holy Light Shield You"

talks.content: Don't push yourself too hard. We still have to save some strength for those Filthoids.
<W>Your hands are drenched in wet, slimy filth, uncertain whether it's the Filthoid's secretions or its innards. Yet, a sudden joy tingles through your soul, bringing an inexplicable elation.</>
Want to rest a bit more?
Never mind, arguing with a youngster isn't worth my time.
Actually, I caught a whiff of something remarkable as you passed by just now.
That's right. It's the scent of a <H>legendary weapon</>! Do you have any special weapons on you, kiddo?
Weapon? This sword is all I have.
(She carefully examined the sword, attempting to glean some information from its pattern.)
Amazing! That's incredible! Look at the texture and the craftsmanship! This clearly wasn't made by those mediocre Hyperborean blacksmiths. Where did you get it?
(The Luno blacksmith recognised that this sword was no ordinary weapon.)
This sword has been with me for as long as I can remember. Maybe it was passed down to me by my parents?
Intriguing. Very intriguing. I've been a blacksmith my whole life, yet I've never seen a weapon like this before.
Kiddo, I'm Lunosmith, a wandering blacksmith. Would you mind if I accompanied you on your journey?
I've travelled all over the land, from Hyperborea to Elysium, and I've forged countless weapons. If you require any weapons, I'm at your disposal.
Wow! So you're an experienced master blacksmith!
All I request is a basic salary, and an opportunity to examine your sword, hehe.

(Some, driven by hunger, have mistaken Eclipta Grass for food.)
(If the poison hasn't set in too deep, this compound can help neutralise the toxins.)
(You've obtained a remedy that might help with Luna's throat)
What's this doing on the floor? This might actually help Luna!
Could you take a closer look? The well-being of flowers hinges on careful observation, but I can't do that now...
